samples.title: Lớp học trực tuyến
samples.prompt: Your friend is interested in online university classes but does not know where to begin. Write an email giving practical advice, explaining a possible difficulty, and offering help.
requirementsVi: Cho bước bắt đầu cụ thể.
Giải thích một khó khăn và cách xử lý.

samples.summaryVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for telling me about your interest in online university classes. I understand why you are unsure where to start. You do not need a perfect plan immediately, but a few practical steps could make things easier.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đồng cảm, xác định mục đích khuyên.

paragraphs.label: Lời khuyên đầu
paragraphs.text: First, I suggest joining an online study workshop at the community centre on Saturday at nine in the morning. There, we can try a short recorded lesson and discuss it in a small group. One useful point is that students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities. For example, a student who works in a restaurant can review a morning lecture after the evening shift.
paragraphs.noteVi: Gợi ý hoạt động có ngày, nơi và lý do.

paragraphs.label: Khó khăn và cách xử lý
paragraphs.text: One thing to remember is that some learners may feel isolated. This can happen because courses sometimes provide recordings without enough opportunities for discussion. A useful response would be to schedule small weekly discussion groups. For instance, a teacher could meet six students at a time and ask each person to explain one difficult point. Try the idea on a small scale before deciding whether to continue.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu giới hạn để lời khuyên không tuyệt đối.

paragraphs.label: Đề nghị và kết
paragraphs.text:
If you like, I can come with you and help you write down the most useful points. Afterwards, we could make a simple plan together.

Please let me know what you think when you have a moment. I would be happy to answer any other questions.

Best wishes,
Minh
paragraphs.noteVi: Hỗ trợ cụ thể, không chỉ nói good luck.
